**0441324 Hadiths of Legislation**  (3 Credit Hours)  
This course includes an introduction to deductive methods; studying and memorizing 30 Hadiths from the book of Subol Al-Salam and Nayl al-Awtar. The course also aims to train the student in using Hadiths in arguments in Fiqh.

---

**0442222 Contemporary Jurisprudence Issues**  (3 Credit Hours)  
This course aims at providing the students with a sufficient Fiqhi knowledge in the contemporary issues about which many questions arise. It also touches on the most significant contemporary fiqhi issues in devotions, financial transactions, and personal conditions, and the opinions of the scholars towards those matters and their methodologies in deriving the fiqhi rulings concerning these contemporary issues.

---

**0442241 Jurisprudence of Personal Status (1)**  (3 Credit Hours)  
This course includes the definition of personal status rules, the marriage contract (its concept, importance, affects), and the methods of canceling the marriage contract (divorce, khul', separating by judgment because of apostasy or breastfeeding, or disagreement between husbands, etc.). The course also includes the influences of canceling the marriage contract, such as: ‘iddah, breast-feeding, nursing, and payment.

---

**0401203 Methodologies of Research in the Sciences of Foundations of Religion**  (3 Credit Hours)  
The course highlights the principles of academic research and the characteristics of successful research in terms of the principles of choosing the material, steps of research, rules of referencing. It concentrates basically on recourses of the fundamentals of Islam i.e. Qur'anic exegesis (interpretation), prophetic sayings, and faith.

---

**0401224 The Islamic Contemporary World**  (3 Credit Hours)  
This course touches on a review of the religious, political, social, and economic conditions of the Islamic world, bringing to the surface the factors of integration between the Islamic countries, the problems the Islamic world faces, and attempts to divide and crumble it. It also deals with the recent changes in terms of the reasons, methods, and outcomes.

---

**0401238 The Scientific Inimitability in the Qur’an and Hadith**  (3 Credit Hours)  
This course aims at proving that the Qur’an and prophetic authentic hadith cannot be from anyone but the Almighty Allah, by showing that there is indeed no contradiction between the Qur’an and the prophetic hadith on one hand and the natural sciences on the other hand, and by showing the scientific magnificent antecedence in the Qur’an and prophetic hadith.
